sandbox.hint_keys: WASD to walk · Q and R turn the camera · mouse wheel zooms · F1 changes the light
sandbox.hint_pad: Left stick to walk · L1 and R1 turn the camera · D-pad up and down zoom · Create changes the light

prompt.controls: {move} to walk · {camera} turn the camera · {interact} use or pick up · {build} build · {clipboard} clipboard · {menu} for the menu
prompt.drop_in: A friend can drop in: {menu} on a second controller
prompt.build_here: {interact} Put a %s here (%s) · {next_kind} next · {rotate} turn · {undo} undo · {build} done
prompt.pack_here: {interact} Pack away this %s (%s back) · {undo} undo · {build} done
prompt.sleep_wait: Ready for bed: %s (%d of %d). {menu} for the menu to join in.
prompt.bed_open: The evening is here. When you are ready, {menu} and choose Ready for bed.
prompt.chop: {interact} Chop wood (%d left in this tree)
prompt.log_alone: Heavy! It goes faster with a friend beside you.
prompt.deposit: {interact} Put your wood and sticks in the camp box

menu.title: Our Little Campground
menu.name: Your name
menu.link_code: Link code (only to bring a couch camper to this PC)
menu.link_info: To play %s on their own PC, join this camp there with the link code %s.
menu.hosting: Hosting camp %d. Your friend can join now.
menu.booking_later: Ask them to come a day later
menu.board_empty: No bookings on the board right now.

join.full: That camp already has two campers.
join.wrong_version: That camp runs a different version of the game.
join.already_here: You are already in that camp.
join.unreachable: Could not reach that camp. Check the address and that the host is in the camp.
join.host_left: The host closed the camp. Your camper waits safely in their save.
join.bad_link: That link code does not match a couch camper in that camp.
join.host_failed: Could not open the camp for a friend. Is another copy of the game already hosting?

save.too_new: That camp was saved by a newer version of the game.
save.unreadable: That camp save could not be read, and neither could its backup.

deny.too_far: That is a little too far away.
deny.out_of_bounds: That would be outside the camp.
deny.too_close: There is not quite enough room there.
deny.coins: Not quite enough coins for that yet.
deny.pitch_in_use: A guest is staying there; it can be packed away after they leave.
deny.too_early: It is a little early for bed. Bed opens in the evening.
deny.not_here: You are not in the camp.
deny.building: Put the build tools away first.
deny.no_water: Find the water's edge to fish.
deny.no_fish: You need a fish to grill.
deny.nothing_to_give: You have nothing they asked for.
deny.no_request: They don't need anything right now.
deny.no_booking: That booking isn't on the board any more.
deny.no_wood: The fire needs a stick or a piece of wood. Gather some, or put some in the camp box.
deny.no_tree: This tree is down. Plant a sapling at its stump and it will grow back.
deny.no_stump: Saplings go in a bare stump.
deny.no_sapling: You need a sapling for that. A fallen tree drops one.
deny.pack_full: Your Pack is full. Drop something ({drop}) or put materials in the camp box.
deny.not_in_kit: None in the kit yet. Craft one at the workbench.
deny.materials: Not quite enough materials for that yet.
deny.nothing_to_box: Only wood and sticks go in the camp box.

toast.left: %s headed home. Their camper is safe in this camp's save.
toast.dropped_out: %s hopped off the couch. Their camper is safe in this camp's save.
toast.pad_asleep: %s's controller went quiet. Their camper waits.
toast.linked: You are playing %s from this PC now. It stays yours here.
toast.booking_declined: You let %s know there's no room this time. No hard feelings.
toast.booking_offer: A new booking is on the board: %s.
toast.spotted_new: You spotted a %s! It is in the journal now.
toast.felled: Timber! The tree fell and dropped a sapling by its stump.
toast.planted: Planted! It will be a tree again in a couple of mornings.
toast.log_split: The long log splits into %d wood for the camp box!
toast.deposited: Into the camp box it goes.
toast.crafted: %s made a %s! It is in the build kit now.

night.title: Good night
night.quiet: Night %d: a quiet night, nobody stayed.

guest.arrived: %s has come to stay at your %s.

improvement.lantern_post: a warm glow for guests nearby

say.chair: Somewhere to sit by my tent?

want.chair: a chair or a log bench by their tent

booking.waiting: Waiting for %d more free pitches; they'll come the first morning you have room.

report.earned: Last night the camp earned %d coins.
report.welcome: Welcome to the campground! It's your first morning. The Today list in the corner says what to try first; either of you can do any task, and each one done pays a little bonus.

goal.fish: catch a fish at the pond.
goal.pitches: make %d more tent pitch(es) before %s come on %s.
goal.ready: %s come on %s, and you have room.
goal.offer: look at the booking board: %s would like to come on %s.
goal.pitch: make another tent pitch for more guests.
goal.cosy: make the camp cosier with chairs by the tents.

task.first_bench: Craft a log bench at the workbench and place it
task.first_grill: Grill a fish at the fire
task.gather: Gather what the woods left out
task.help_guests: Help guests with what they asked for

place.edges: at the edges of the clearing
place.woods: from the edge of the woods

task.first_plant: Plant a sapling at a stump
task.bring_log: Bring the long log to the fire (easier together)

news.day_2: berries ripen on the bushes, and deer visit the edge of the woods at dawn and dusk.
news.day_3: the Fern family arrive if you took their booking, and someone big and fluffy may come to sit by the fire after dark. Friendly, they say.
news.day_5: the birdwatchers arrive if you took their booking.

clipboard.hint: {tabs} turn the page · {clipboard} put it away
clipboard.answer: Answer a new booking from the menu ({menu}).
clipboard.nobody: Nobody yet. Guests come to a free pitch in the afternoon.
clipboard.content: nothing more, happy as can be

options.title: Options
options.wait_key: Press the new key. %s or a click keeps the old one.
options.wait_button: Press the new button on the controller. Wait a moment to keep the old one.
options.reserved: %s is kept for something else, so nothing changed.
